info.title: SDKWork Models Backend API
info.description: Intelligence catalog API owned by sdkwork-models. Materialized from composed host catalog mount OpenAPI authority.

get.description: List model mapping rules with SQL-backed offset pagination and optional binding/vendor/channel/search filters.

parameters.name: vendor_code
parameters.description: Filter mappings by source, target, or binding vendor code.

parameters.name: channel_id
parameters.description: Filter mappings by channel binding id encoded as int64 string.

parameters.name: channel_code
parameters.description: Filter mappings by channel binding code.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search on vendor codes, mapping items, and binding labels.

post.description: Create model mapping. Reads ai_model_mapping_rule, ai_model_mapping_rule_binding, ai_model_mapping_rule_item. Writes ai_model_mapping_rule, ai_model_mapping_rule_binding, ai_model_mapping_rule_item, ops_audit_log. File targets none.
Resolve a model mapping rule without creating or mutating catalog state.

delete.description: Delete model mapping. Reads ai_model_mapping_rule, ai_model_mapping_rule_binding, ai_model_mapping_rule_item. Writes ai_model_mapping_rule, ai_model_mapping_rule_binding, ai_model_mapping_rule_item, ops_audit_log. File targets none.

patch.description: Update model mapping. Reads ai_model_mapping_rule, ai_model_mapping_rule_binding, ai_model_mapping_rule_item. Writes ai_model_mapping_rule, ai_model_mapping_rule_binding, ai_model_mapping_rule_item, ops_audit_log. File targets none.

get.description: List model rankings. Reads ai_model_rank_snapshot, ai_model. Writes none. File targets none.
List model ranking refresh jobs. Reads ops_job_execution, ai_model_rank_snapshot. Writes none. File targets none.

post.description: Trigger model ranking refresh. Reads ai_usage, ai_model. Writes ai_model_rank_snapshot, ops_job_execution. File targets none.

parameters.description: Required stable idempotency key for this write operation.

get.description: Retrieve model ranking refresh status. Reads ops_job_execution, ai_model_rank_snapshot. Writes none. File targets none.
List vendors. Reads ai_model_vendor. Writes none. File targets none.

post.description: Create vendor. Reads ai_model_vendor. Writes ai_model_vendor, ops_audit_log. File targets none.

get.description: List models page. Reads ai_model_vendor, ai_model, ai_model_capability, ai_model_pricing. Writes none. File targets none.

post.description: Create model. Reads ai_model_vendor, ai_model, ai_model_capability, ai_model_pricing. Writes ai_model, ai_model_capability, ai_model_pricing, ops_audit_log. File targets none.
Sync vendors and models. Reads ai_model_catalog_sync_run. Writes ai_model_catalog_sync_run, ops_audit_log. File targets none.

delete.description: Delete model. Reads ai_model. Writes ai_model, ai_model_capability, ai_model_pricing, ops_audit_log. File targets none.

get.description: List tenant-visible AI resource groups with SQL-backed offset pagination. The default stable sort is tenant override, sortOrder, then id; page_size defaults to 20 and is capped at 200. This is a P1 administrative list.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search on resource-group code, name, and description.

post.description: Create resource group. Reads ai_resource_group, ai_resource_group_item, ai_resource. Writes ai_resource_group, ai_resource_group_item, ops_audit_log. File targets none.

get.description: List resources in a tenant-visible AI resource group with SQL-backed offset pagination. The default stable sort is membership or resource sortOrder, then id; page_size defaults to 20 and is capped at 200. This is a P1 administrative list.

parameters.description: Group id or code path parameter.
parameters.name: groupIdOrCode
q
parameters.description: Free-text search on resource code, display name, vendor, modality, endpoint, catalog key, and model fields.

delete.description: Delete resource group. Reads ai_resource_group, ai_resource_group_item. Writes ai_resource_group, ai_resource_group_item, ops_audit_log. File targets none.

patch.description: Update resource group. Reads ai_resource_group, ai_resource_group_item, ai_resource. Writes ai_resource_group, ai_resource_group_item, ops_audit_log. File targets none.

put.description: Idempotently assign one API resource to a tenant-owned manual resource group, or update its role and sort order. The group row is locked and the membership mutation and audit event commit in one transaction.
put.summary: Assign or update a resource-group member

delete.description: Idempotently detach one API resource from a tenant-owned manual resource group in the same transaction as its audit event.

get.description: List tenant-visible AI resources with SQL-backed offset pagination. The default stable sort is tenant override, sortOrder, then id; page_size defaults to 20 and is capped at 200. This is a P1 administrative list.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search on resource code, display name, vendor, modality, endpoint, catalog key, and model fields.

parameters.name: resource_type
parameters.description: Filter by the canonical AI resource type.

post.description: Create a tenant-owned AI resource, including model access channels and their public routing metadata. Credentials are not accepted by this catalog API.

put.description: Update a tenant-owned AI resource and its public model access channel metadata. Credentials are not accepted by this catalog API.

parameters.description: Filter by model catalog key vendor/modelId.

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: Filter by model id when combined with vendor_code.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search on displayName and voiceId.

parameters.name: modelId

parameters.name: vendor_code
parameters.description: Required when model id is not a catalog key.
